The word lists (assets/dict_*.bin) include the word forms of these Hunspell dictionaries, expanded
from their affix rules by tools/dict/unmunch.py. Source: https://github.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries

ro/ro_RO  Romanian. Available under the GPL, the LGPL or the MPL, at your choice
          (COPYING.GPL, COPYING.LGPL, COPYING.MPL in the source directory).
en/en_US  English (US), from SCOWL. Copyright 2000-2018 by Kevin Atkinson and the other
          contributors named in README_en_US.txt; permission to use, copy, modify, distribute
          and sell the word lists is granted without fee, with the copyright and permission
          notices kept, as stated there.
en/en_GB  English (UK), under the LGPL, as stated in README_en_GB.txt.
